clues: I was born in Ulm, Germany, in 1879.
I worked as a clerk in a Swiss patent office.
I won the 1921 Nobel Prize in Physics for the photoelectric effect.
My most famous equation involves mass and the speed of light.
I was the last active ruler of a dynasty founded by a general of Alexander the Great.
I spoke many languages and was the first of my dynasty to learn the local tongue.
I had relationships with two of Rome's most powerful men.
Legend says I died from the bite of an asp.
I sit on the border of two countries.
Locals call me Chomolungma or Sagarmatha.
Tenzing Norgay and Edmund Hillary are famous for reaching my top.
I am the highest mountain on Earth.
